name: CSTA PK–12 Computer Science Standards (2026)
summary: What students should know and be able to do in computer science from pre-K through high school, with high school specialty standards in areas such as AI, cybersecurity and data science.

license.note: Non-commercial and share-alike; the Computer Science Teachers Association handles other licensing requests.

cite: Computer Science Teachers Association. (2026). 2026 CSTA PK–12 computer science standards. https://doi.org/10.1145/3820482

fits.how: A standard's text could be an activity's context, as Learning Commons standards are; under a non-commercial license, only as opt-in context.

connect.note: Comes down as its PDF, which a local run doesn't read as knowledge, so nothing is made from it. Non-commercial and share-alike: asks you to accept its license first.
